Name: Shallum, King of Israel
Summary: Shallum, son of Jabesh, conspired against Zachariah, smote him before the people, and reigned one month in Samaria before Menahem slew him.
RelatedPeople: Zachariah, King of Israel; Menahem, King of Israel; Jabesh, Father of Shallum
LifeLesson: A throne taken by murder is seldom kept longer than a month.
